bank: EYES AND EARS -- E15 [machine judges] -- THE PRE-JUDGE PASS, SPEC ONLY
note: DRAFT MATERIAL, NEVER WIRED INTO THE GAME. School's corrections: (1) a pre-judge that annotates but still forwards everything ADDS work, because the bottleneck is his attention, not the absence of information; (2) the rubber stamp is measurable in advance and a 0% override rate is a process failure, not proof the machine is right; (3) the bottleneck MOVES, so measure the queue before accepting the premise; (4) EVERYTHING IS A THUMB already abolished the approvals queue, so the legitimate shape is fewer things reaching him, not better-prepared things.

read_to_ground_it_not_measured.E7_sheet: 7 machine questions (detail order, colour density, saturation budget, value band, grain scale, light, reads at play size) and 3 human ones (same material, belongs to this world, what a stranger would call it)
read_to_ground_it_not_measured.DIRECTION_load: 6 open or claimed lines on the board
read_to_ground_it_not_measured.caution: six claimed lines is a COUNT, not a queue measurement. it says nothing about how long each has waited or whether anything is blocked behind them.

step_zero_and_it_is_not_optional.do: measure the queue before accepting the premise: how many cooks are actually waiting on DIRECTION, how long has each waited, is anything blocked behind them
step_zero_and_it_is_not_optional.if_direction_is_not_the_constraint: report that and STOP, rather than building a machine for a bottleneck that is somewhere else
step_zero_and_it_is_not_optional.why: theory of constraints: relieve the current constraint and the focus moves to the next one. and queueing theory says wait times rise non-linearly with demand, so the classic lever is smaller batches, not faster screening.

the_three_outcomes.means: fails one of E7's 7 machine questions, or the contrast number
the_three_outcomes.goes: back to the cook, NEVER reaches DIRECTION
the_three_outcomes.note: THIS IS THE ONLY OUTCOME THAT SUBTRACTS FROM HIS QUEUE

the_three_outcomes.means: passes everything a machine can judge and a defensible default exists
the_three_outcomes.goes: ships, under EVERYTHING IS A THUMB; he corrects it by playing

the_three_outcomes.means: passes the machine but turns on one of the 3 human questions
the_three_outcomes.goes: reaches him, GROUPED BY WHICH QUESTION, so he rules once per decision instead of once per cook

the_override_meter.record: every DIRECTION verdict that contradicts a machine verdict
the_override_meter.the_alarm: a sustained 0% override rate is reported as a PROCESS FAILURE OF THIS PASS, not as proof the pass is right
the_override_meter.why: automation bias is documented across medicine, aviation and code review: when a system is usually right people stop checking. clinical alert systems see 49 to 96% of safety alerts dismissed. declining override rates are the named leading indicator of rubber stamping.
the_override_meter.the_principle: a checker that cannot notice it has been switched off is the failure this lane exists to catch

print_nothing_on_a_pass.rule: the machine's job is to be SILENT when it passes; a cook that clears everything produces one word, not a report
print_nothing_on_a_pass.why: excessive nitpicking obscures serious problems. forty machine findings per cook buries the one thing he was needed for.

where_it_lives.rule: in the gate suite, not in a tool somebody remembers to run
where_it_lives.why: local validation alone gets bypassed under deadline pressure, which is exactly the rounds where it would have mattered. and this repo's own pillar law says a law without a machine gate is not enforced.

rule_zero.trap: a pass that returns DECIDED for everything looks exactly like a pass that is working

controls.plant: a cook built to fail a specific machine question (wrong value band, or a palette that is not the world's)
controls.must: come back RETURNED and NAME the question it failed

rule_zero.rule: if the planted failure passes, the sheet is not being applied and every verdict is void

the_law_that_reframes_the_job.law: EVERYTHING IS A THUMB (Paolo 8/9, LOCKED): the default flipped from approve-before to correct-after; a numbered queue of pending verdicts is banned outright
the_law_that_reframes_the_job.consequence: a pre-judge whose output is a nicer approval packet rebuilds the machine that law tore down, one level up. THE LEGITIMATE SHAPE: the machine decides, the cook ships, DIRECTION corrects what it hates.
the_law_that_reframes_the_job.so_the_real_job_may_be: make the machine's decision good enough to ship on, and send DIRECTION only the cooks where no defensible default exists -- a smaller queue by construction rather than a faster one

blind_spots_to_declare: a machine question answered on a thumbnail is not the same question answered on the real surface
E7's 7 machine questions were validated against one corpus and have not been re-validated since
the pass measures conformance to a reference and can never measure appeal, which is why the other 3 questions exist
a cook that passes every machine question can still be boring, and no machine will ever find that
what_this_lane_may_not_do: judge taste, or decide what any cook should look like (that is DIRECTION's, and the taste is his)
write game code or change any cook
add a job to another lane's queue beyond the one [eyes: two words] bounce-back line
